doctrine: DL-166. A public identifier that ships in the bundle by design — today only a Firebase web API key — is accepted by the sha256 of its value, recorded here by the person who supplied it. A key is not a secret, but an unrecorded one in the artefact is one nobody classified: check:bundle and check:environments both fail on it. Record a key only once it is restricted in Google Cloud to the console's origins and to the Identity Toolkit and Token Service APIs. Staging and production are separate Firebase projects with separate keys. Staging has a key (taytay-lgu-ids-staging, 2026-11-05); production has none yet.

entry.sha256: hex sha256 of the exact key string
entry.restrictedTo: origins and APIs, as configured in Google Cloud

identifiers.restrictedTo: APIs: identitytoolkit.googleapis.com and securetoken.googleapis.com only (set 2026-11-05). HTTP-referrer restriction NOT yet set: the staging console has no approved origin; add it when one is chosen.
